hints.title: Concatenate Strings
hints.text: Concatenate word1 and word2 into combined string s. The problem is related to longest palindromic subsequence.

hints.title: Non-Empty Subsequence Requirement
hints.text: The palindrome must use at least one character from word1 and at least one character from word2.

hints.title: Check Boundary Crossings
hints.text: Whenever s[i] equals s[j] with i < len(word1) and j >= len(word1), record dp[i][j] as a valid candidate length.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subsequences of both strings takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2D longest palindromic subsequence table evaluates all subproblems in O((n + m)^2) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate enforces that at least one outer matching pair crosses the word1 and word2 boundary.
